text: ぬすまれた　わざマシンは　マンキーや　サンドに　じめんに　あなを　ほる　わざを　おしえる　ものだ！

structure.jp: ぬすまれた　わざマシンは
マンキーや　サンドに
structure.en: to Mankey, Sandshrew and the like

structure.jp: じめんに　あなを　ほる　わざを
structure.en: the move for digging holes in the ground
is a thing that teaches it!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぬすまれた　わざマシン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'the ... that ...' in English. ぬすまれた　わざマシン = 'the TM that was stolen'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: ぬすむ 'steal' changed to ぬすまれる means the thing has it done to it. ぬすまれた = 'was stolen'.
